Evan Park: Hi all, quick onboarding questions: I picked the HSA-eligible plan during enrollment but don't see an HSA vendor link. How do I set up contributions? Also my offer mentioned a $1,000 relocation reimbursement  I have receipts, where do I send them? Finally, my first paycheck looks smaller than expected  is that normal?
Maya (People Ops): Welcome @Evan! Short answers: HSA vendor (HealthSaver) enrollment is separate from benefits elections. After benefits confirm, you'll get an invite from HealthSaver to open the account and set pre-tax payroll contributions. If you don't get the invite in 48 hours, ping us.
Maya (People Ops): Relocation reimbursements: upload receipts to Expensify under policy "Relocation - People Ops" and include Offer ID (OFFER-8124). We require itemized receipts and dates. If you paid in a foreign currency, include a bank conversion screenshot.
Evan Park: Thanks  I need cash earlier, can we request an advance? Also what documents prove residency for dependent coverage?
Maya (People Ops): Yes, relocation advances are possible. File a ticket to the people-ops queue titled "Relocation Advance - Evan Park" with amount and receipts; we try to respond in 24 business hours. For dependent/residency proof we accept joint lease, utility bill within 60 days, joint bank stmt, or domestic partner affidavit + two supporting docs.
Payroll Bot: Payroll note: New-hire proration applies for mid-cycle starts. Estimated pay date for first payroll run: 2026-05-07. Deductions for benefits begin the first pay period after coverage effective date.
Evan Park: Perfect, I uploaded the relocation receipts and my lease PDF to Expensify and the benefits portal. Appreciate the fast help! :thumbsup: 
Recruiting Bot: Recruiting note: Offer paperwork for Evan Park (OFFER-8124) shows relocation eligible up to $1,000; finance approval pending.
Maya (People Ops): Confirming I see your uploads. I'll follow up if carrier or finance need anything else. If approved, reimbursement typically posts within 1-2 payroll cycles.
